context._comment: Deploy inputs are read from ../.deploy/agent.json (written by the RCS agent setup in SETUP.md step 2, or by an AI coding assistant that follows AGENTS.md). You can override at deploy time: cdk deploy -c rcsAgentId=rcs-xxxx -c region=us-east-1
context._bedrockComment: bedrockModelId/bedrockRegion are intentionally NOT set here. A value in this block would override the defaults in lib/config.ts for every deployer, and a geography-scoped inference profile pinned here (for example us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) fails at runtime wherever bedrockRegion is not a source Region for that profile. Override per deploy instead: cdk deploy -c bedrockModelId=eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6. Unset, the defaults are global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (resolves in every Region) and the deploy region.
